topic: Purpose and operation of various safety devices used in electrical system of the aircraft.
syllabus_extract: Purpose and operation of various safety devices used in electrical system of the aircraft. Safety precautions while working on electrical systems in aircraft.
specific_objectives: 25.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to know and understand the constructional details of starters, ignition units and principles of. operation of various engine instruments

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of circuit breaker reset mechanism and fuse replacement procedure with instructor supervision
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a circuit breaker in an aircraft electrical system?
Why are safety precautions critical when working on aircraft electrical systems?
Can you list three common safety devices found in aircraft electrical systems?

development.content:
Purpose of circuit breakers
Operation of thermal circuit breakers
Fuse types and ratings
Arc suppression devices
Ground fault protection

Safety precautions for electrical work
Lockout/tagout procedures
Personal protective equipment requirements
Handling high voltage components
Disposal of damaged electrical parts

topics: Impact of electrical faults on aircraft systems
development.content:
Review of safety device failures
Impact of electrical faults on aircraft systems
Maintenance intervals for safety devices
Troubleshooting common electrical issues
Importance of regular inspections

summary_questions: Explain the difference between a thermal circuit breaker and a magnetic circuit breaker.
Describe the correct procedure for replacing a blown fuse in an aircraft electrical system.
List three safety precautions that must be followed before working on aircraft electrical systems.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the importance of regular inspection of safety devices in aircraft electrical systems, referencing the next lesson plan (LP 02) on starters and ignition units.
